chain.title: Sage Seeds
chain.desc: Break grass and tall grass; a global loot modifier scatters sage seeds among the wheat seeds. The first Hexerei item anyone finds.

chain.title: Sage
chain.desc: Plant the seeds on farmland. Sage is the herb the whole mod is built on, from the book's cover to the smoke that clears curses.

chain.title: Animal Fat
chain.desc: Cows, pigs and sheep drop fat through loot modifiers. Melted in the cauldron it becomes tallow, and tallow is what candles and the Book of Shadows are made with.

chain.title: Book of Shadows
chain.desc: A Book, Leather, Sage Seeds and anything meltable into tallow. It is the mod's guide, and it can be dyed and placed on an Altar.

chain.title: Mahogany
chain.desc: Mahogany trees grow in dark, damp biomes alongside Willow and Witch Hazel. Mahogany is the witch's timber and every device below is framed in it.

chain.title: Altar
chain.desc: Mahogany Planks and a Mahogany Slab. Rest the Book of Shadows on it to read hands-free and to mark the corner of your workroom.

chain.title: Mixing Cauldron
chain.desc: A vanilla Cauldron, an Iron Ingot and a Torch. This is the mod's crafting core: fill it with water, blood or tallow, drop the ingredients in, and stir. Almost everything below is a cauldron recipe.

chain.title: Drying Rack
chain.desc: Sticks, String and any wooden slabs. Hang fresh herbs on it and they dry over time into the potent form the recipes want.

chain.title: Dried Sage
chain.desc: Sage left on the Drying Rack. Dried herbs are the currency of the cauldron.

chain.title: Dried Sage Bundle
chain.desc: Tie Sage with String, then dry the bundle. Lit, a sage bundle smoulders and cleanses the area around it.

chain.title: Pestle and Mortar
chain.desc: Iron, Quartz and Stone in the cauldron. It grinds berries into dye and herbs into the blends the candles need.

chain.title: Herb Jar
chain.desc: Sand in the cauldron. A jar that holds one herb in bulk and shows what is inside, so a wall of them is a working herb shelf.

chain.title: Sage Burning Plate
chain.desc: A single Gold Ingot in the cauldron. Set a sage bundle on it and it burns continuously, keeping the smoke going without your attention.

chain.title: Infused Fabric
chain.desc: Black Dye, Leather and String in the cauldron. The mod's cloth: it becomes the robes, the blocks, the carpets and the broom seat.

chain.title: Witch's Hat
chain.desc: Infused Fabric shaped into the pointed hat. The Robe, Boots and the rest of the set come from the same cloth.

chain.title: Small Satchel
chain.desc: A Gold Nugget, Leather and String in the cauldron. Upgrade it into the medium and large satchels, then into the Ender Satchel.

chain.title: Coffer
chain.desc: Mahogany Planks and Gold in the cauldron. A lockable strongbox, and the block the coven chests in worldgen are stocked from.

chain.title: Dipper
chain.desc: An Iron Ingot and an Iron Nugget in the cauldron. Fill the cauldron with tallow, hang string on the dipper, and dip repeatedly to build a candle layer by layer.

chain.title: Bottle of Blood
chain.desc: Bottle blood straight out of a filled Mixing Cauldron. Blood is the fuel of the darker half of the mod and every broom needs a bottle of it.

chain.title: Nature Coven
chain.desc: One of the four settlements the mod generates, alongside the Dark Coven, the Owl Post Office and the Witch Hut. Its herb store fills chests/nature_coven_herbs with Mandrake Root and every dried herb, and its crow room holds flutes and amulets.

chain.title: Mandrake Root
chain.desc: Pull a fully grown Mandrake Plant, or loot the herb chests of a Nature Coven. The root screams, and it is the binding agent in every broom and amulet.

chain.title: Crow Flute
chain.desc: Mahogany Planks and any dye. Crows are tameable birds that gather, harvest and pickpocket for you; the flute selects them and assigns their orders.

chain.title: Crow Ankh Amulet
chain.desc: A Blank Amulet with dried Mugwort and Yellow Dock, Glow Berries and a Totem of Undying in the cauldron. Fitted to a crow it brings the bird back from death.

chain.title: Mahogany Broom
chain.desc: A Mahogany Log, a Bottle of Blood, a Mandrake Root, Wheat and a Netherite Ingot in the cauldron. Brooms are ridable entities with their own fuel and upgrade slots; Willow and Witch Hazel are the cheaper gold and diamond variants.

chain.title: Broom Brush
chain.desc: Cauldron a Wet Broom Brush from Mandrake Root, Mugwort and Yellow Dock leaves and Wheat, then dry it on the rack. The brush slot sets how fast the broom flies.

chain.title: Broom Seat
chain.desc: An Infused Fabric Block, a Small Satchel, Leather and String. It adds a passenger seat and carries the satchel's storage into the air with you.

chain.title: Broom Netherite Tip
chain.desc: A Selenite Shard, a Netherite Ingot and Netherite Scrap. The tip slot is the broom's durability and handling; the waterproof tip is the prismarine alternative.

chain.title: Dark Coven
chain.desc: The Nature Coven's opposite number. chests/dark_coven_basic is the only worldgen source of Animal Fat, Bottles of Blood and a ready-made Blood Sigil, and its coffer room is stocked with gold.

chain.title: Blood Sigil
chain.desc: Polished Blackstone and Redstone in the cauldron. Placed and fed, the sigil is the dark coven's marker and the entry point to the mod's blood work.

notes: Verified twice against hexerei-0.4.2.3.jar, whose META-INF/mods.toml declares minecraft [1.20.1,1.20.2] under javafml with no neoforge.mods.toml, and which Modrinth lists as version 1.20.1-0.4.2.3 for forge. Pass 1: 357 item models intersected with item./block. lang keys = 268 ids (item_count_in_jar). Pass 2 rebuilt 813 ids independently from blockstates, all 1271 recipe jsons, loot tables and tags; pass 1 is a subset. HEXEREI'S RECIPE SET IS UNUSUAL: 1066 of its 1271 recipes are hexerei:woodcutting entries, which are the three wood sets being cut into each other and carry no progression at all. The real progression is only 36 hexerei:mixingcauldron recipes, 13 hexerei:drying_rack, 15 hexerei:dipper, 4 hexerei:pestle_and_mortar and 97 crafting-table recipes, and the chain above is read from those. DROPPED AS UNOBTAINABLE (registered, but no recipe, no loot table, no tag and no worldgen source anywhere in the jar): hexerei:armor_scrap and hexerei:scrap_block; the four hexerei:druid_ armour pieces and the four hexerei:orc_ pieces; hexerei:fire_tablet; hexerei:quicksilver_bottle and hexerei:quicksilver_bucket; hexerei:tallow_bucket, hexerei:blood_bucket, hexerei:tallow_impurity and hexerei:milk_bottle (the bottle forms of these fluids DO have cauldron_emptying recipes and are used instead); hexerei:budding_selenite and the small, medium and large selenite buds; hexerei:broom_thruster_brush; hexerei:creative_waxing_kit. These read as work-in-progress content in a 0.4.x mod and would all be uncompletable quests. hexerei:selenite_shard is kept because blocks/selenite_cluster drops it. SOURCING for the non-crafted steps: sage_seed from data/hexerei/loot_modifiers/sage_seeds_from_grass.json and _from_tall_grass.json; animal_fat from animal_fat_from_cow/pig/sheep.json plus chests/dark_coven_basic; mandrake_root from chests/nature_coven_herbs and from harvesting a grown Mandrake Plant; mahogany_log from blocks/mahogany_log and worldgen. The mod ships four structures documented in its own book pages - Dark Coven, Nature Coven, Owl Post Office and Witch Hut - with loot tables chests/dark_coven_basic, dark_coven_coffer, nature_coven_coffer, nature_coven_crow, nature_coven_herbs and courier_package. ENTITIES: hexerei registers crow and owl (both with spawn eggs and real spawn rules) plus mahogany_broom, willow_broom and witch_hazel_broom, which are ridable vehicles rather than mobs, and boat and chest_boat. No kill step is emitted: the crow and owl are tameable helpers with no hostile behaviour and no loot table of their own - the only entity loot table in the jar, entities/crow_pickpocket_villager, is the table a tamed crow rolls when it steals from a villager, not a death drop. CONSENSUS CONFLICT (recipe graph preferred): moddb.json's 17 Hexerei entries put hexerei:blood_bottle dead last at pos 1.0 while putting hexerei:mahogany_broom at 0.438, but data/hexerei/recipes/mahogany_broom_from_mixing_cauldron.json lists hexerei:blood_bottle as an ingredient - the consensus ordering is impossible. The same list puts hexerei:broom_netherite_tip at 0.312, ahead of the broom it attaches to and ahead of both hexerei:infused_fabric at 0.5 and hexerei:pestle_and_mortar at 0.562, even though the tip costs a Netherite Ingot, Netherite Scrap and a Selenite Shard. Membership agreement with the consensus is otherwise good: 15 of its 17 items appear in this chain. Variant families kept in wheels: the mahogany building set (Willow and Witch Hazel are identical sets and are left out entirely), the herb and dried-herb family, the satchel and trinket family, and the broom accessories. Slabs, stairs, walls, fences, doors, signs, boats and the waxed and stripped variants of all three woods are excluded.
